description: This file is a client entry point for a Remix application, responsible for hydrating the app on the client side using React. It imports necessary components and functions from Remix and React, then uses React's startTransition to hydrate the root component within StrictMode.

methods.name: startTransition
methods.description: Wraps the hydration process to allow React to handle updates concurrently.

methods.name: hydrateRoot
methods.description: Hydrates a React app into a DOM element, replacing the existing content.
